text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Colitis.

The patient's presentation of sudden periumbilical pain, bloody diarrhea, and recent hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction strongly suggests ischemic colitis due to hypoperfusion. I will not proceed with further questioning or tests as the clinical picture is sufficient for this diagnosis.
